import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process'

const hash = value => createHash('sha256').update(value).digest('hex')
const root = '/workspace/pnd-baseline-144-buildings'
const base = '7cb339d01713b3ec3c7e1f46bbdd6d78a5fca86f'
const candidate = '651b989768907a33e37d1d4ac435a71074885e47'
const load = name => {
  const receipt = JSON.parse(readFileSync(`work/orchestration/${name}`, 'utf8'))
  assert.equal(receipt.phase, 'finished')
  assert.deepEqual(receipt.source, receipt.sourceAfter)
  assert.equal(hash(receipt.stdout), receipt.stdoutSha256)
  assert.equal(hash(receipt.stderr), receipt.stderrSha256)
  return receipt
}
const full = load('issue144-buildings-focused-651b989.json')
const previous = load('issue144-buildings-baseline-focused-7cb339d.json')
assert.equal(full.source.headOid, candidate)
assert.equal(previous.source.headOid, base)
assert.equal(full.status, 'passed')
assert.equal(full.exitCode, 0)
assert.equal(previous.status, 'failed')
assert.equal(previous.exitCode, 1)
assert.deepEqual(full.command, previous.command)
assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(full.source.inputs), Object.keys(previous.source.inputs))
for (const [path, value] of Object.entries(full.source.inputs)) {
  assert.equal(hash(readFileSync(path)), value, path)
  if (path !== 'app/scene-entities.ts') assert.equal(value, previous.source.inputs[path], path)
}
assert.match(full.stdout, /pass 6\n.*fail 0/)
assert.match(previous.stdout, /pass 5\n.*fail 1/)
assert.match(previous.stdout, /completed-only full caller read 2144 IDs for 64 buildings/)
assert.equal(
  execFileSync('git', ['diff', '--name-only', 'HEAD'], { cwd: root, encoding: 'utf8' }).trim(),
  ''
)
assert.equal(previous.source.trackedDiffSha256, hash(''))
const original = execFileSync('git', ['show', `${base}:app/scene-entities.ts`], {
  encoding: 'utf8',
})
assert.equal(hash(original), previous.source.inputs['app/scene-entities.ts'])
assert.equal(
  hash(readFileSync(`${root}/app/scene-entities.ts`)),
  previous.source.inputs['app/scene-entities.ts']
)
const source = readFileSync('app/scene-entities.ts', 'utf8')
const start = 'export function updateBuildingsFrame(scene: GameScene) {'
const end = '\nexport function updateShrinesFrame'
const planPhase = (value, boundary) =>
  value.slice(value.indexOf(start), value.indexOf(boundary, value.indexOf(start)))
assert.equal(
  planPhase(source, '  let buildingIds = buildingFrameIds.get(scene)'),
  planPhase(original, '  for (const [id, g] of scene.buildingMeshes)')
)
const body = value => {
  const from = value.indexOf('      releaseHutSmoke(scene, g)', value.indexOf(start))
  assert.ok(from >= 0)
  return value.slice(from, value.indexOf(end, from))
}
assert.equal(body(source), body(original))
const lint = load('issue144-buildings-oxlint-651b989.json')
const oldLint = load('issue144-buildings-baseline-oxlint-7cb339d.json')
for (const receipt of [lint, oldLint]) {
  assert.equal(receipt.status, 'failed')
  assert.equal(receipt.exitCode, 1)
}
assert.equal(lint.source.headOid, candidate)
assert.equal(oldLint.source.headOid, base)
assert.deepEqual(lint.command, oldLint.command)
for (const [path, value] of Object.entries(lint.source.inputs))
  if (path !== 'app/scene-entities.ts') assert.equal(value, oldLint.source.inputs[path], path)
const diagnostics = receipt =>
  receipt.stdout
    .trim()
    .split('\n')
    .map(line => line.replace(/:\d+:\d+(?=: (?:warning|error))/, ':<line>:<column>'))
    .sort()
assert.equal(diagnostics(lint).length, 9)
assert.deepEqual(diagnostics(lint), diagnostics(oldLint))
console.log(
  JSON.stringify(
    {
      focusedCandidate: 'passed 6/6',
      actualUnmodifiedBase: 'failed: five passed, scaling failed at64 with2144 ID reads',
      pairedInputHashes: full.source.inputs,
      productionBaseUnchanged: true,
      earlierPlanPhaseUnchanged: true,
      cleanupAndFullLaterBuildingBodyUnchanged: true,
      strictOxlintCandidate: 'failed',
      strictOxlintBase: 'failed',
      diagnosticMultiset:
        'passed: nine exact inherited diagnostics; only numeric line/column prefixes normalized',
      scalingScope:
        'completed-only population, preparation map empty, units zero, secondary effects quiet; occupancy and puff scans excluded',
    },
    null,
    2
  )
)
